description: TSFM lab arm table — the measured rolling-origin verdicts the kairos claims ledger is scored against ('kairos = arm 11'). Ratios are arm-vs-baseline CRPS (or Brier) skill ratios on the lab's independent harness; verdicts are Diebold-Mariano tested. Committed verbatim from worklog/20261027_KAIROS_CLAIMS_LAYER_DESIGN.md section 0 (re-measured 2026-10-27 after the trend/regime covariate fix).

provenance.lab: TSFM Probabilistic Forecast Lab (independent harness, built outside this repo; arms frozen, DM-tested with Newey-West variance)
provenance.caveat: Lab cells are arm-vs-baseline RATIO tables. Kairos claims resolve at horizon 48h (the settlement contract window), so the leaderboard joins lab cells by SYMBOL as context and provenance — never number-vs-number across different horizons. The leaderboard's primary statistic is the PAIRED bracket-vs-vol_fan DM test inside the ledger (same signal, same bars, same resolver, same units).

params.metric_semantics: crps_ratio < 1 = arm beats baseline (lower is better); brier = mean Brier score (lower is better); verdicts: PASS = DM-significant win, FAIL = DM-significant loss or no skill, UNPROVEN = right direction, not significant
